_comment: Retired archive slug -> surviving canonical slug. The upstream Guitar Geek filename grammar produced two or more slugs for the same person (token permutations, separator variants, spelling variants, and an unstripped 'rig_' prefix). Every pair below was confirmed against data/rigs.json: matching year plus matching filename stem, or a pure token permutation of the same name. Rigs on a retired slug are re-parented onto the survivor; none are dropped. Retired slugs 301 to the survivor via next.config.ts and are absent from the sitemap.
